1: // Neon Runner – minimal endless runner
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the page.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 200;
10: 
11:   // Game settings
12:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 20;
13:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
14:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
15:   const OBSTACLE_WIDTH = 20;
16:   const OBSTACLE_GAP = 150; // distance between obstacles
17:   const SPEED = 4;
18: 
19:   let player = { x: 50, y: height - PLAYER_SIZE, vy: 0, onGround: true };
20:   let obstacles = [];
21:   let frameCount = 0;
22:   let running = true;
23: 
24:   function spawnObstacle() {
25:     const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'spike' : 'gap';
26:     const x = width;
27:     if (type === 'spike') {
28:       obstacles.push({ type, x, y: height - PLAYER_SIZE, w: OBSTACLE_WIDTH, h: PLAYER_SIZE });
29:     } else {
30:       // gap: just a space the player must jump over; represent as invisible obstacle for collision check
31:       obstacles.push({ type, x, w: OBSTACLE_WIDTH, gap: true });
32:     }
33:   }
34: 
35:   function update() {
36:     // Player physics
37:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
38:     player.y += player.vy;
39:     if (player.y >= height - PLAYER_SIZE) {
40:       player.y = height - PLAYER_SIZE;
41:       player.vy = 0;
42:       player.onGround = true;
43:     } else {
44:       player.onGround = false;
45:     }
46: 
47:     // Move obstacles
48:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= SPEED);
49:     // Remove off‑screen obstacles
50:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
51: 
52:     // Spawn new obstacles
53:     if (frameCount % Math.floor(OBSTACLE_GAP / SPEED) === 0) spawnObstacle();
54: 
55:     // Collision detection
56:     for (const o of obstacles) {
57:       if (o.type === 'spike') {
58:         const collides =
59:           player.x < o.x + o.w &&
60:           player.x + PLAYER_SIZE > o.x &&
61:           player.y < o.y + o.h &&
62:           player.y + PLAYER_SIZE > o.y;
63:         if (collides) running = false;
64:       } else if (o.type === 'gap') {
65:         // gap is a hole: if player is over the gap and not jumping enough, lose
66:         const overGap = player.x + PLAYER_SIZE > o.x && player.x < o.x + o.w;
67:         if (overGap && player.onGround) { running = false; break; }
68:       }
69:     }
70: 
71:     frameCount++;
72:   }
73: 
74:   function draw() {
75:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
76:     // draw player (neon cyan)
77:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffff';
78:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE);
79:     // draw obstacles
80:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff00ff'; // neon magenta for spikes
81:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
82:       if (o.type === 'spike') {
83:         ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
84:       } else if (o.type === 'gap') {
85:         // visualize gap as a dark rectangle (optional)
86:         ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
87:         ctx.fillRect(o.x, height - PLAYER_SIZE, o.w, PLAYER_SIZE);
88:         ctx.fillStyle = '#ff00ff';
89:       }
90:     });
91:   }
92: 
93:   function loop() {
94:     if (!running) {
95:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
96:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
97:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
98:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
99:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
100:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
101:       return;
102:     }
103:     update();
104:     draw();
105:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
106:   }
107:

110:   window.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); if (player.onGround) player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY; }, { passive: false });
111: 
112:   // start
113:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
114: })();
